title: Engineer IT
description:
The **Engineer – IT** will support and maintain production operator IT, cloud, and telecom infrastructure. The role includes resolving hardware, operating system, software, network, server, virtual machine, security, backup, access management, and voice-connectivity issues, as well as coordinating with operator IT teams and cloud service providers to maintain service availability.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Operator IT Infrastructure & Security

* Attend to and resolve production hardware (HP, Dell, Lenovo, IBM) and network-related complaints.
* Resolve production operating system (Linux and Microsoft Windows) and software-related complaints.
* Coordinate server resource upgrades, including RAM and HDD.
* Configure web publishing/hosting on IIS Web Server.
* Monitor production server hardware health and alerts; maintain production asset data.
* Manage software and operating system licences, production server backups, user accounts, access permissions, and passwords.
* Submit URL whitelisting and firewall-opening requests to the Operator IT Team.
* Create VPN user IDs with the operator support team for Operations & Maintenance access.
* Apply server security patches, support closure of security audit findings, and perform OS hardening.
* Integrate with security platforms such as SIEM, ViPAM, LDAP, and FireEye.
* Perform pre-activity and post-activity sanity checks for planned telecom activities and confirm service functionality.
* Support operator-side platform changes, such as proxy and SMTP gateway migrations.
* Provide network-level troubleshooting using Wireshark and support IPsec VPN tunnels.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Security

* Resolve production Linux, Microsoft Windows, and software-related issues in cloud environments.
* Coordinate virtual machine (VM) resource upgrades with the Cloud Service Provider.
* Configure web publishing/hosting on IIS Web Server.
* Monitor production VM health and alerts; maintain production VM asset data.
* Manage software and operating system licences, VM backups, user accounts, access permissions, and passwords.
* Submit firewall-opening requests to the Cloud Service Provider and create VPN user IDs with the provider for Operations & Maintenance access.
* Apply security patches to VMs, support vulnerability closure, and perform OS hardening.
* Perform pre-activity and post-activity sanity checks for planned activities and support cloud-provider platform changes. Provide Wireshark-based network troubleshooting and IPsec VPN tunnel support.

3. Telecom Infrastructure Support

* Support the Customer Desk in resolving customer call-connectivity complaints, including packet capture (pcap) and Wireshark trace analysis.
* Attend to and resolve E1/SIP media and channel-state complaints.
* Support voice-channel upgrades and E1 rearrangements as required.
* Submit call-routing requests to the Operator Switch.
* Monitor the health of production server voice circuits.

Education & Qualifications:

Any degree or a three-year diploma.

Mandatory Skills / Certifications :

* Course completion or certification in Linux (RHCE) – mandatory.
* Course completion or certification in Computer Hardware Service – mandatory.
* Course completion or certification in Microsoft Windows Server Administration (MCSE/MCP) – mandatory.

Preferred / Optional Skills :

* Course completion or certification in Cisco Networking (CCNA/CCNP).
* Course completion or certification in DevOps.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
---------------

Develop reliable robotics software and firmware that connect onboard computers, microcontrollers, sensors and actuators. Own assigned modules from design and implementation through integration, testing and technical documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop C++ ROS 2 nodes, interfaces, actions and lifecycle-managed components for ROV systems and payload automation.
* Write embedded C/C++ for microcontrollers, peripheral interfaces, actuator control, watchdogs and local fault handling.
* Use Python for test automation, hardware simulation, diagnostics and engineering utilities.
* Define hardware and software interfaces; integrate sensors and actuators over CAN, UART, SPI, I2C or Ethernet as applicable.
* Implement interlocks, timeouts, command validation and safe recovery; debug failures across firmware, communications and ROS 2.
* Maintain reviewed code, reproducible builds, test evidence and documentation; support bench integration and supervised vehicle trials.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

1–3 years of hands-on experience in robotics software, embedded firmware or closely related engineering. Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated practical experience.

Candidates should be able to explain code they have built, integrated and debugged. Underwater robotics experience is preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

**Must-have technical skills**

* C++: object-oriented design, ownership and memory management, state machines, concurrency and debugging.
* Python: scripts, automated tests, data handling and simulation of hardware interfaces.
* ROS 2: packages, topics, services, actions, parameters, launch files, lifecycle nodes, executors and basic QoS.
* Embedded programming: microcontrollers, GPIO, timers, interrupts, PWM, serial interfaces, watchdogs and safe startup behavior.
* Linux, Git, CMake and colcon; ability to diagnose timing, communication and integration faults.

Preferred: STM32/ESP32 or equivalent, RTOS fundamentals, CAN, bench debugging with a logic analyzer or oscilloscope, and software/hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Behavioral competencies: structured problem solving, clear communication, ownership, careful documentation and collaboration with mechanical, electronics and testing teams.

**What you will do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.

* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.

* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have qualifications**

**1. Technical**

* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as **Java, C++, C#, Python**, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.

**2. Behavioral**

* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer to drive our product from first idea to live release and beyond. You will combine hands-on engineering with product ownership: owning the requirements, leading several engineering teams, and making sure what we build is technically sound and matches what customers and the business need.  
This role sits at the centre of product and engineering. You will turn business goals into a clear roadmap and technical plan, shape the architecture, guide teams through design, development, testing and release, and stay hands-on where it matters, through code reviews, prototypes and solving the hardest technical problems. You are accountable for quality, timelines and outcomes.

Key responsibilities  
1. Product development from start to finish

* Shape the product vision and roadmap with leadership, based on business goals, customer feedback and market research.
* Lead each product or feature through its full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, release and post-launch review.
* Define the minimum viable product (MVP) and plan releases in phases.
* Decide what gets built, what waits and what is dropped, using clear prioritisation (value, effort, risk).
* Review released features against goals and plan improvements.
* 2. Requirements ownership
* Act as the single owner of product requirements and the product backlog.

* Gather requirements from customers, sales, support, operations and leadership; resolve conflicts between them.
* Write clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that teams can build and test against.
* Keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready at least two sprints ahead.
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change process and explain their impact on time and cost.
* Accept or reject completed work against the agreed acceptance criteria.

3. Managing multiple teams4. Technical oversight5. Delivery and stakeholder management

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams: development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps and business analysis.
* Plan sprints and releases across teams; manage dependencies, shared resources and handoffs.
* Run or oversee Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Set clear goals for each team, track progress, and remove blockers quickly.
* Coach team members, give regular feedback, and support hiring and onboarding.
* Build a culture of ownership, quality and open communication.
* Work with architects and tech leads on solution design, technology choices and technical debt.
* Make sure non-functional needs are planned in: performance, security, scalability and reliability.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases and cloud basics well enough to judge trade-offs.
* Ensure quality through code review practices, test coverage and CI/CD standards.
* Own delivery timelines, budget and risks; raise issues early with options.
* Report progress, risks and results to leadership and stakeholders in plain language.
* Coordinate go-live with support, training, marketing and operations teams.
* Track product metrics and use data to guide decisions.Qualifications and skills

* Strong hands-on coding skills in at least one modern back-end stack (such as Java, Node.js) and working knowledge of a front-end framework (React or Angular).
* Experience designing scalable systems: microservices, REST or GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ClickUp or Azure DevOps.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical people.

title: Product Engineer
description:
About Nutcracklab

Nutcracklab is an AI analytics company building intelligent products that help businesses make better decisions using data, predictive analytics and artificial intelligence.We are building a portfolio of AI\-driven products across multiple business domains and are looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to help take these products from MVP and prototype stages into reliable, production\-ready systems.

Required SkillsMust Have

· **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**

· Strong **Python** development skills

· Strong **SQL** skills

· Experience with **PostgreSQL** or equivalent relational databases

· Experience building **REST APIs**

· Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent**

· Strong experience with **Pandas / NumPy**

· Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics or AI applications

· Experience with **Git/GitHub**

· Experience with **Docker**

· Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment

· Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills

· Understanding of software architecture and production engineering practices

Preferred

· Experience with **Microsoft Azure**

· Azure ML or equivalent ML deployment experience

· Experience with **Streamlit**

· Data engineering / ETL

· API and third\-party system integrations

· CI/CD and GitHub Actions

· Application monitoring and logging

· Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture

· Experience taking products from **prototype/MVP → production**

· Experience working in **retail, e\-commerce or other data\-intensive business domains**

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

· Is comfortable working with incomplete or evolving requirements.

· Can make practical architecture and technology decisions.

· Can balance speed of delivery with engineering quality.

· Enjoys working across multiple technical areas rather than being restricted to one narrow function.

· Has strong product thinking in addition to coding ability.

· Is comfortable working directly with founders and customers.

· Is excited by the opportunity to build new products from the ground up.

Why Join Nutcracklab?

This is an early\-stage opportunity with significant technical ownership.

You will have the opportunity to:

· Build AI products from the ground up.

· Work directly with the founder.

· Influence architecture and technology decisions.

· Work across AI, data and product engineering.

· Take products from **idea → prototype → MVP → production**.

· Help establish the company’s engineering culture and technical foundation.

· Eventually help build and lead the engineering team as the product portfolio grows.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
